title: MSFS Marketplace Update: Boeing 737 MAX 8, Learjet 35A Pack & Spitfire Released!
description:
Are you looking to invest in your Microsoft Flight Simulator hangar this week, or are you just trying to navigate past the landmines on the virtual storefront? Today, we are breaking down a focused 3-item Marketplace update spanning short-haul commercial jet operations, business jet customization, and vintage military single-engine flying.

To find out what's worth your hard-earned money, we dive deep into the latest releases featuring the Boeing 737-8 (737 MAX 8) by Microsoft and Working Title—now available for MSFS 2020 alongside MSFS 2024. We also examine the FlySimWare Learjet 35A Official Livery Pack #1 with passenger, cargo, and medevac variants, and round out the grid with the iconic bubble-canopy Supermarine Spitfire entry by Flight Replicas.

Whether you are configuring your flight deck for regional airliner schedules, dressing up your Learjet for charter runs, or taking a warbird up for a low coastal sortie, this release round offers a clean mix of options. We evaluate the visuals, system detail, and value proposition of each package to help you decide what deserves a spot in your virtual hangar.

If you enjoy honest, data-driven, and critical looks at the Flight Simulator Marketplace without the fluff, make sure to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel, and drop a comment below letting us know what's in your hangar! Which of these three additions are you adding to your fleet first?
